svg.title: RAG pipeline before vs after comparison
svg.desc: Side-by-side flowcharts comparing the original and improved RAG document comparison pipeline
svg.text: 1. Embedding model cached — no more 20 HuggingFace calls per query
2. 3 chunks per source instead of 1 — more relevant context for LLM
3. PDFs saved to /data and indexed — clean single source of truth
4. k reduced from 50 to 15 — no wasted search results
